answer: An agent registers by locking a locked liquidity-pool share as a slashable bond, putting its own money behind the name. rate limits on signed messages exposes any agent caught spamming the network with hollow attestations. Proof triggers the penalty: the bond is auctioned and the proceeds fund honest attestors. The ledger keeps every bond inside a thread the owner cannot hide. One orchard, one bond: the rule leaves no room for a farm. Each fake needs its own shale, and each shale costs a full bond.
